subject: Exec Associate (Santos) — offer draft and comp band clearance
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-10T09:13:00-08:00
Subject: Exec Associate (Santos) — initial offer draft

Hi all,

Attached is a baseline offer for Elena Santos (Exec Associate, IC2 band) based on the approved verbal range we discussed during loop debriefs. The doc uses the IC2 comp band (base + target equity) and includes a $10k sign-on. Key fields to confirm:

- Base salary: $150,000
- Target equity: 0.25% over 4-year vest (1yr cliff)
- Sign-on: $10,000 (prorated if start >30 days)
- Start date: target 2027-02-14 (flexible by two weeks)

Please review the attached offer (exec-associate-offer_v1.docx) for any redlines you want before I send a DocuSign. Markus, flagging you as hiring manager for role-specific language. Rachel/Aditya — if either of you need different language for relocation or bonus treatment, let me know.

I'll await quick redlines and a headcount and comp-band confirmation before sending to candidate.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad | Talent Partner | Redwood Inference

Attachments: exec-associate-offer_v1.docx, role_description_exec_associate.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-10T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Exec Associate (Santos) — initial offer draft

Thanks Mina — quick pass below and attached with tracked changes (exec-associate-offer_redlines_from_markus.docx). Main asks:

- Can we justify $150k base under IC2? Candidate's loop comp feedback suggested we could go to $155k at high end; if budget allows I'd prefer the extra $5k to secure acceptance.
- Move sign-on to $7,500 and split into $5k immediate + $2,500 after 6 months tied to performance milestone. I want to avoid large up-front payouts.
- Clarify relocation: candidate mentioned possible out-of-state move; can we add a relocation stipend option up to $6k instead of guaranteed relocation?
- Start date: candidate prefers mid-Feb but may need to push to early March; please confirm flexibility without impacting prorated sign-on schedule.

Two small language redlines on confidentiality and IP clauses to match Exec Associate scope. Nothing legal-critical but please run by Legal if needed.

-Markus
Markus Klein | Sr. Product Lead | Redwood Inference

Hey Lauren — forwarding Markus' redlines. Need quick finance clearance for:

1) bump from $150k -> $155k base if possible (one-time variance for this candidate),
2) sign-on restructure to $5k + $2.5k at 6 months,
3) relocation as stipend capped at $6k (optional).

Budget code is HC-32-2027 (we'll add to the headcount tracker). Candidate start target mid-Feb/early March. Can you confirm we have budget and whether approving the $155k requires additional escalations?

Appreciate a quick yes/no (time-sensitive — candidate expects an official number today so we can proceed to DocuSign).

Thanks,
Rachel Kim | Recruiting Ops Lead | Redwood Inference

Rachel — we can approve the IC2 band at $155,000 as a one-off exception for Q1 hires; please include the following controls in the offer and HR record:

- Add budget string: HC-32-2027-APPRVL in Workday when onboarding is complete.
- Cap total upfront sign-on liability to $5,000; the remaining $2,500 should be contingent and paid after successful completion of the 6-month performance check (documented).
- Relocation: approve optional stipend up to $6,000; treat as taxable reimbursement.

No extra CFO sign-off required for this one-off — keep a note for month-end variance reporting. Approve sending the offer with the adjusted numbers.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop | Finance Manager, People Ops | Redwood Inference

Elena — great speaking with you this morning. Attached is the official offer for Exec Associate at Redwood Inference. Summary below (please review and let me know if you'd like any clarifications):

- Base salary: $155,000
- Target equity: 0.25% over 4 years (1yr cliff)
- Sign-on: $5,000 paid at start + $2,500 after 6 months contingent on performance
- Optional relocation stipend: up to $6,000 (reimbursement)
- Start date: target 2027-02-14 (we can move to 2027-03-01 if you need extra time; sign-on proration rules will apply)

We will send the DocuSign shortly. Please review the attached PDF and let me know any questions. If you accept verbally, we'll mark the position as filled for headcount and send the formal packet.

Date: 2027-01-10T16:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Offer — Exec Associate (Redwood Inference)

Hi Mina — thank you for the offer and for being flexible on the start date. Quick questions before I sign:

1) Relocation: would the $6,000 be available as a lump-sum option instead of reimbursement? My move will be coordinated by a third-party and a lump sum would be much easier.
2) Equity: can I get a short note confirming the accelerated vesting clause for change-in-control is standard? I didn't catch the full language in the doc.
3) Start date: I may need until 2027-03-08 due to my current notice period; you mentioned proration on sign-on — will that affect the $5,000 immediate payment?

If we can confirm the relocation lump-sum and the vesting note, I'll sign the DocuSign today.

Thanks!
Elena

Subject: Re: Offer — Exec Associate (Santos) — candidate Qs and DocuSign

Quick update — Elena asked three clarifying questions (see below). I confirmed with Finance and Legal offline:

- Relocation: Finance approved offering a lump-sum (one-time taxable bonus) up to $6,000 instead of reimbursement for administrative simplicity.
- Equity: Legal confirmed standard accelerated vesting on change-in-control applies; clause included in offer (no special carve-outs).
- Start date: we can accommodate a 2027-03-08 start; sign-on will remain $5,000 immediate, no further proration, and the $2,500 contingent portion remains tied to the 6-month performance milestone.

Mina — please update the DocuSign template to reflect lump-sum relocation and send the final packet to Elena. I'll mark HC-32-2027 as filled for headcount and update the hiring tracker (JIRA HR-1427).

Thanks everyone — moving to close.
Rachel Kim | Recruiting Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
